title: Expectation commutes with a finite list sum
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $f\colon\alpha\to(\Omega\to\mathbb{R})$. The uniform expectation over $x\in\Omega$ of the sum of $f(a)(x)$ over entries $a$ of $l$ equals the sum over entries $a$ of $l$ of the uniform expectation of $f(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ assigns a real-valued function on $\Omega$ to each element of $\alpha$
